statement: At seq_len=64, Titans persistent memory adds 20% VRAM overhead (691→828MB) and reduces throughput 1.57× (271→173 tok/s), with no statistically significant loss benefit (Full: 3.1425, No-Titans: 3.1420, t=0.1211). Titans expected to provide benefit only at seq_len>=512 where memory state accumulates meaning.
evidence_completeness: PARTIAL — long-context benefit NOT YET tested (MISSING-002).
